sloka: क्व गतो लप्स्यसे शर्म भर्तुः मम महात्मनः ।निमेष अन्तर मात्रेण विना भ्रातरम् आहवे ॥३-५३-२३॥
transliteration: kva gato lapsyase śarma bhartuḥ mama mahātmanaḥ ।nimeṣa antara mātreṇa vinā bhrātaram āhave ॥3-53-23॥

translations.english: Rama has killed fourteen thousand demons alone without his brother within a moment. He is a strong warrior and wellversed in the use of all kinds of weapons. You have stolen his loving wife. How can he live without killing you.
translations.hindi: अतः इससे सुमे बड़ा क्रोध हुआ है. ओर इस क्रोध ने मेरे कर्य को भी दबा लिया हे । श्रीराम के साथ सेरा बड़ा भारी बंर हो गया है
